findings.label: Unpaginated admin transactions endpoint
findings.description: GET /admin/payments/transactions hard-codes limit(500) with no offset or cursor. Add pagination parameters or switch to cursor-based paging before production.

findings.label: Old transactions unrecoverable by webhook
findings.description: Payments completed before this fix have transactionRef = 'REF-...' in the DB. Incoming webhooks carry IN331#... so findOne returns null and raisedAmount is never updated. Use POST /admin/payments/mark-success/:transactionId to manually recover these after verifying payment externally.

findings.label: Frontend placeholder text unchanged
findings.description: The donation modal input still shows 'min. 100 XAF' but validation now enforces 15 XAF. Update the placeholder in donation-modal.component.html.

findings.label: Test-only minimum should revert
findings.description: The 15 XAF minimum is temporary (user confirmed). Revert to 100 XAF in four places (initiateDonation, initiateSupport, donation-modal submit(), platform-support-modal submit()) before production deployment.

findings.label: Recap threshold inconsistency
findings.description: platform-support-modal template shows the recap div when effectiveAmount >= 1 but validation requires >= 15. Change the *ngIf condition to effectiveAmount >= 15.
